title: LXP Industrial Trust Leases 1.2 Million Square Foot Development Project in Phoenix
summary: WEST PALM BEACH, Fla., April 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - LXP Industrial Trust (“LXP”) (NYSE:LXP), a real estate investment trust focused on Class A warehouse and distribution real estate investments, today announced that it has pre-leased its 1.2 million square foot speculative development project in Phoenix to a U.S. subsidiary of a global logistics company. The lease is expected to commence on December 1, 2026, for a five-year lease term at an initial annual cash base rent of $9.8 million, with 3.5% annual rental escalations. The estimated total project cost is approximately $122 million with the lease signing resulting in an estimated development cash yield of approximately 8.0%. T. Wilson Eglin, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of LXP, commented, “We’re excited to have pre-leased our 1.2 million square foot development project in the West Valley submarket of Phoenix to a full building user.
